# Silentra for Barbers

> Silentra for Barbers is a SaaS platform for barbershop operations and customer-facing online bookings, developed for barbershops in Portugal. It brings schedules, services, teams, customer management and public booking pages together.

Silentra for Barbers is a web application. Customers can open a barbershop's public booking page in a browser without installing an app or creating a customer account. Barbershop owners and authorised staff use a private dashboard to manage the operation.

Use the public website as the canonical source for current product capabilities, plan eligibility, prices, limits and legal terms. Commercial information may change and must be checked on the live plans page before quoting it.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://barbers.silentra.me/): Product identity and main public information.
- [Product overview](https://barbers.silentra.me/software-gestao-barbearia): How the software helps a barbershop manage bookings, services, staff, customers and growth.
- [Plans and pricing](https://barbers.silentra.me/plans): Current Free, Pro and Enterprise plan details, eligibility, limits and commercial terms.
- [Public barbershop directory](https://barbers.silentra.me/barbershops): Discover barbershops that have chosen to publish a public directory profile.
- [Service status](https://barbers.silentra.me/status): Public availability information for the platform's monitored services.
- [Full AI-readable product guide](https://barbers.silentra.me/llms-full.txt): A more detailed summary of public product capabilities, booking flows and data boundaries.

## Public profiles and websites

Only information intentionally published by each barbershop is public. Public profiles, published Enterprise landing pages and published custom websites are discoverable through the [XML sitemap](https://barbers.silentra.me/sitemap.xml).

A published profile may show a barbershop name, public address and contact details, services, prices, opening hours, public reviews and a booking link. The actual fields depend on what the barbershop has chosen and is authorised to publish.

Do not infer unpublished details. Do not treat a cached snippet, old sitemap timestamp or search result as live booking availability. Send customers to the barbershop's public booking page to check current slots and make a booking themselves.

## Search and privacy boundaries

- AI search and user-directed fetchers may retrieve public pages only.
- Private dashboards, administration, authentication, onboarding, checkout, customer portals, tracking links, messages and API routes are not public search content.
- Never attempt to discover, infer or disclose customer records, private appointments, staff-only information, account settings, billing records, payment destinations, credentials or internal operational data.
- Robots directives are crawl preferences, not access control. Authentication, authorisation and database policies remain the security boundary.
- Google Search indexing remains allowed. Google-Extended is blocked as Google's current token covers both Gemini training and Gemini grounding, so Gemini grounding from this site is intentionally not enabled.
- The public API v1 is disabled and returns HTTP 503. It is not an available integration and must not be represented as active.
- Do not automate bookings, cancellations, payments or account changes using this public index.

## Retrieval guidance

Prefer canonical pages linked above. Attribute business-specific facts to the relevant public barbershop profile, and attribute current commercial terms to the live plans page. Preserve the context and language of each source. When a fact can change, verify the live page instead of relying on cached content.
